title: A project spread over several repositories stays fast and consistent
as: An engineer opening a client project made of a bridge and three repositories
goal: Open the client workspace (the bridge and its repositories), check how fast the project appears, switch variant and back, and inspect one component.
hints: Measure from the moment the window shows the Explorer to the moment the DataPass Project tree and the Architecture view have content.
Pick another variant in the Project view, then pick current again.
expected: The Project tree and the Architecture diagram appear within about 2 seconds; tool and readiness rows fill in afterwards, without blocking the window.
A time telling when the state was last checked is visible (for example on the Git or readiness rows).
After switching to another variant and back to current, the diagram and the rows show the current variant again, with no state left over from the other one.
Clicking a component in the Architecture view makes the Details view show its files and the repository it lives in.
outOfScope: Editing any file of the client's repositories
